definitions.explanation: Each and every evening. A somewhat formal time expression used in writing and news.

examples.japanese: {毎夕|まいゆう}ジョギングをしている。
{毎夕|まいゆう}{六時|ろくじ}にニュースを{見|み}る。
examples.english: I watch the news at six every evening.

examples.japanese: {毎夕|まいゆう}の{散歩|さんぽ}が{日課|にっか}になっている。
examples.english: An evening walk has become part of my daily routine.

notes:
USAGE:
{毎夕|まいゆう} is a formal time word meaning "every evening." In everyday conversation, {毎晩|まいばん} (every night) or {毎日|まいにち}{夕方|ゆうがた} (every day in the evening) is more common.

SERIES:
Part of a series of {毎|まい} + time compounds:
- {毎朝|まいあさ} (every morning)
- {毎昼|まいひる} (every noon — rare)
- {毎夕|まいゆう} (every evening)
- {毎晩|まいばん} (every night)
- {毎週|まいしゅう} (every week)
- {毎月|まいつき} (every month)
